verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a compliance and audit platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence describes a self-hosted, on-prem, or downloadable deployment of Thoropass. The docs instead describe an invite-based hosted platform (welcome emails from support@thoropass.com) and ask customers to allowlist Thoropass IP addresses so its monitors can reach their systems, which points to a vendor-run SaaS model.
